messages:
olivia: Heads up — noticed a p95 jump on the latency dashboard for /v2/infer after yesterday's routing tweak. p50 steady, p99 unchanged. anyone else seeing this?
rahul: saw it too in eu-west, roughly 18:30 UTC. p95 moved from 120ms -> 300ms for a ~10% traffic slice.
sasha: hmm are we including retries in the endpoint timing? routing change introduced a fallback to cpu-quantized variant.
olivia: good call — dashboard currently labels 'endpoint latency (server_time)'. not sure if that includes retry/fallback time.
marc: it depends on the ingestion path, we have two codepaths: service reports 'service_time' and gateway adds transport+retry. dashboard aggregation uses the event that made it to metrics pipeline. we tagged the retry path differently but maybe the tag didn't make it through the rollup.
kevin: can you paste the query you used to filter? I want to reproduce.
olivia: quick snippet: `service:api.backend endpoint:/v2/infer | by route, region | p95(1000ms) over 5m` — ran against last 24h.
rahul: FYI deploy-bot shows the routing change: `deploy-bot: rollout 2026-03-18T18:15 -> routing.weight policy: prefer-low-cost-region 0.9 -> fallback variant quantized-cpu`
sasha: if fallback path adds an extra proxy hop + kv-cache miss, that could inflate p95 but not p99 if rare. but 10% of traffic getting fallback is non-trivial.
marc: question — are we merging samples from service and gateway without provenance? percentiles computed with tdigest aggregates, mixing sources with different clocks can distort p50/p95.
kevin: agreed — we need a 'sample_provenance' tag surfaced in the UI. quick patch idea: add small badge on percentile tiles showing origin: service/gateway/cache/retry.
olivia: proposal: add a toggle in console to 'exclude retries' and 'show provenance' for percentile tiles. UX team asked for minimal toggles though.
rahul: implementation detail: ingestion currently strips internal flags for privacy. we can keep a hashed provenance label (kvcache|retry|primary) so no internal names leak.
sasha: also surface whether percentile includes prefix/KV cache hits. those dramatically shift median. maybe a tiny sparkline that splits cache-hit vs cache-miss p50/p95.
marc: for correctness we should mark which aggregation mode is used: tdigest vs sample-reservoir. tdigest can underweight tail when merged incorrectly. Rollouts that shift route weights can show weird step changes.
kevin: short-term: add a query param `?include_retries=false` to telemetry API and wire console toggle to it. Long-term: add provenance badges and split-view.
olivia: can someone file a tiny RFC/PR? i'll start a design mock for the toggle and split sparkline. feature should also surface cost delta (fallback -> higher latency usually = higher cost).
rahul: I'll open a telemetry PR to keep provenance in rollups hashed. will add tests for merge stability (simulate route weight shift).
sasha: tests should include scenario: 90% route A (fast), 10% fallback B (slow) and then weight flip to 50/50 to catch quantile jumps.
marc: note: we should document whether percentile endpoints include transport time and retries. current docs are ambiguous. small docs PR after we lock behaviour.
kevin: +1, and add a console tooltip: "Percentiles may include retries/transport/kv-cache. Toggle to filter."
deploy-bot: note: routing rollback scheduled if p95 > 250ms for 30m in prod.
olivia: thanks — i'll coordinate with oncall if we see >250ms sustained. for now action items: rahul telemetry PR, olivia mock, kevin console toggle stub, sasha test scenarios.
marc: ping me on the PRs, i'll review quantile merge logic.
kevin: i can take the console wiring this afternoon.
olivia: awesome. tiny note — let's ensure timestamps used in merged histograms are monotonic or we get pctl inversion artifacts.
rahul: noted. i'll add monotonicity checks to the merge job.
olivia: thanks team :thumbsup:
